hana: Quick a11y notes from testing the compact Export modal with VoiceOver + keyboard. Short list for triage. peter: drop 'em in here. hana: findings: • Modal traps focus but Close button not reached by Shift+Tab when opened from toolbar (focus lands on page body) • Export CTA in dark theme fails AA at 12px (3.3:1) • Status text updates during export use aria-live=polite per-token -> VoiceOver floods users • File type checkboxes have no aria-describedby for the helper copy (SR reads checkbox but not the explanation) olivia: thanks. priority? hana: focus restore + live-region consolidation P0. contrast + checkbox helper P1. dev_jay: plan: 1) ensure openerButton.focus() on modal close 2) change live updates to a single announcer that reports completion "Export complete: 3 files" 3) bump export token or bold label to hit 4.5:1 4) add aria-describedby to each checkbox pointing to helper text a11y-bot: Automated scan: 4 issues (2 high: focus restore, live-region flooding; 2 medium: contrast, missing aria-describedby). Report: /internal/a11y/reports/1912345678 peter: can you paste the minimal snippets for PR? dev_jay: snippets: 1) focus restore: `onClose() { openerButton.focus(); setOpen(false); }` 2) announcer: `
` then update only on complete: `announcer.textContent = `Export complete: ${n} files`;` 3) checkbox: `
Comma separated values format
` olivia: copy tweak: tooltip -> "Export selected models" and tooltip for CTA -> "Export models as CSV" so SR has context. hana: i'll re-test after PR merges and post one-line verification. thanks :sparkles:
